import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietoris
import MumfordLib.SingularCochainMayerVietoris

/-! Exactness of singular cohomology Mayer--Vietoris for an open cover. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits HomologicalComplex

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X)

/-- Singular cohomology Mayer--Vietoris exactness, transported from the
simplicial small-chain sequence across the comparison isomorphisms. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_of_compat
    (n : ℕ) (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hcover : U ∪ V = Set.univ)
    (hcompat :
      (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv ≫
          homologyMap (integralSimplicialCochainIntersectionDifference
            (singularSubset X U) (singularSubset X V)) n =
        singularCohomologyOpenCoverDifference X U V n ≫
          ((singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V) n).symm ≪≫
            simplicialCohomologyIso
              (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).symm n).hom) :
    (singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n).Exact := by
  let A : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex := singularSubset X U
  let B : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).Subcomplex := singularSubset X V
  let e₁ := singularUnionCohomologyIso X U V hU hV hcover n
  let e₂ := (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).symm
  let e₃ := (singularSubsetCohomologyIso X (U ∩ V) n).symm ≪≫
    simplicialCohomologyIso
      (SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)).symm n
  let S := (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex A B).map
    (homologyFunctor (ModuleCat ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ) n)
  let eS : singularCohomologyMayerVietoris X U V n ≅ S :=
    ShortComplex.isoMk e₁ e₂ e₃ (by
  · dsimp [A, B, e₂, S, singularCohomologyMayerVietoris,
      simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex]
    rw [singularUnionCohomologyIso_hom]
    change _ = singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n ≫
      (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv
    apply (cancel_mono (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom).1
    have hcancel :
        (singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n ≫
          (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).inv) ≫
            (singularPairCohomologyIso X U V n).hom =
          singularCohomologyOpenCoverRestriction X U V n := by
      simp
    conv_rhs => rw [hcancel]
    exact singularPairCohomologyIso_restriction X U V n) (by
    dsimp [A, B, e₂, e₃, S, singularCohomologyMayerVietoris,
      simplicialCochainMayerVietorisComplex]
    exact hcompat)
  exact (ShortComplex.exact_iff_of_iso eS).mpr
    (simplicialCohomologyMayerVietoris_exact_pair A B n)

end Mumford.Analytic
